about: DRAFT, never run. MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B (qwen35moe language model on Qwen3.5/3.6, SigLIP2 vision) at Q5_0 from openbmb's GGUF repository, with its f16 image projector (minicpmv4_7, 16x token compression by default) and the DSpark draft from the same repository (dspark-*-F16.gguf, actually BF16: dflash architecture with the DSpark Markov and confidence heads, 15-token blocks; draft-dspark, n-max 15 as openbmb's DSpark card runs it), all on the RTX Spark N1X's GPU. Upstream llama.cpp b11718: MiniCPM-V 4.7 landed in #29416 (2026-10-10), DSpark drafts in #26275/#27804, and dflash.cpp loads the Markov/confidence heads this file carries. The chat template thinks by default (enable_thinking unset opens <think>), so --reasoning-format deepseek; the card only publishes instruct-mode sampling (temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, top-k 100, min-p 0, repetition penalty 1.03), used here. 10 of 40 layers hold KV (2 heads x 256): 262,144 tokens is 5 GiB f16, plus up to 2.5 GiB for the 5-layer draft's KV.
setup: One RTX Spark N1X. 25.9 GB of downloads (23.98 GB Q5_0 GGUF + 1.12 GB mmproj + 0.79 GB DSpark draft). Expected resident memory ~34 GiB at 262,144 tokens (24.1 GiB weights, 7.5 GiB f16 KV for target and draft, compute buffers). Known upstream issue: llama.cpp #30510 (open) fixes wrong M-RoPE positions for MiniCPM-V 4.7's image marker tokens, which shift returned grounding coordinates; captions and OCR are unaffected. openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark-gguf@9a6d35b9 has a 0.42 GB Q8_0 of the same draft if the BF16 one slows decode. No network at runtime: the draft is a pinned file mounted with the model.
